decisions.reason: Fronts the closed-eyes beat so the sentence leads into the thought instead of the calqued “I thought with my eyes closed.”
Keeps 퀘스트 창 as Quest Window; BASE drops Window and softens 적힌 대로라면 into a looser “just like the Quest says.”
Same fact, tighter sentence; “only three days remained” matches 고작 사흘밖에 남지 않았다 without the extra “there were.”
Keeps 단 한 번의 예외도 없는; SOL’s “every single bout” drops the no-exception emphasis.
그리고/심지어 is a further beat; “And he hasn’t even” carries that additive sting.
Same handicap claim, but the Peak-master topic is phrased as native English instead of “it was an enormous handicap for.”
Preserves 지도 아래; SOL’s “under Sword Saint Mae Jonghak” drops the guidance.
Keeps 현 and 최고; SOL drops “current” and weakens “greatest” to “finest.”
Omitted subject of 달라 is Cheongpung in context; BASE’s vague “this” is weaker.
Korean is 청풍의 움직임; SOL drops Cheongpung from the recalled object.
“Grace itself” is the English match for 유려, 그 자체다; BASE paraphrases.
스스로의 강함 is his own strength; SOL’s “genuine strength” changes the claim.
이라 이거지 is a so-that’s-it realization; BASE drops the “so.”
“Contend with” is the more natural collocation for a weapon that can face Sword Energy.
승부해야 돼 is beating Cheongpung with martial arts; “beat him” is more spoken and object-clear than abstract “win.”
Keeps 내게 있어; SOL deletes the personal framing.
Turns the System-tide sentence into natural English without losing the blocked-attack → death logic.
말 그대로 is “literally”; SOL’s “quite literally” intensifies it.
고수는 많다 is many masters, not “everywhere.”
대비하기 위해서는 is purpose, not SOL’s extra “if I wanted to” hedge.
똬리를 틀었다 is coiling in the dantian; BASE’s “curled back up” loses the coil image.
Keep 진가심법의 경지 as the technique’s realm; 체력과 피로가 회복됩니다 is one recovery verb covering both.
decisions.replacement:
> **System**
>
> - You have successfully completed circulating your qi.
> - The realm of the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique has risen slightly.
> - Your stamina and fatigue have recovered.

decisions.reason: 접전 is a battle; “exchange” softens it and weakens the correction that follows.
정정한다 is “Correction”; 박 터지게 맞는 is the beating idiom, but the callback still has to say battle, not exchange.
decisions.replacement: Correction. It wasn’t a fierce battle. Mujin was just getting the crap beaten out of him.

decisions.reason: 정신을 못 차리던 as “disoriented” in one sentence is cleaner than “unable to keep his senses amid.”
빛살 is a ray; “beam” is only a synonym swap.
수천, 수만 is an escalating count, not SOL’s unsupported self-correction “thousands—no.”
Makes Cheongpung the evader and the chest thrust the follow-up, instead of the awkward “found … thrusting.”
Whooosh better matches elongated 쐐애애액; Whoosh is just the generic spelling.
“Stripped of all unnecessary movement” is tighter for 군더더기 없이 than “without any.”
상대가 나빴다 is “wrong opponent,” not a direct “too strong.”
부르르 is a violent tremble, and the force is Mujin pouring strength into the seized blade.
The English technique name plus the catch on-page already explain 공수납백인; the footnote is redundant.
Parallel “one’s … one’s opponent’s” is cleaner than “the opponent’s” after “one’s martial arts.”
수치 플레이 is humiliation, but the flushed face still needs Hyuk Mujin’s name after a general technique line.
decisions.replacement: Hyuk Mujin’s face flushed red at the unexpected humiliation.

decisions.reason: The interrupted “Putting more strength into it won’t—” is closer to the cut-off 소용 없…….
Korean is putting force into the seized sword; SOL invents “straining against the fingers.”
저 자식 is that bastard, not this.
웃음이 나왔다 is a laugh escaping; “fought so honestly” recasts 정직한 무공 without a glossary break.
Colon list is cleaner, and 실리를 취하는 is seizing the advantage, not “taking advantage of the opening.”
실수 is a mistake and 실력 is skill; BASE’s “problem” / “too strong” drift.
Keep 한 사람의 신형 as someone’s body; “sailed” is better than “went flying,” and “at my feet” is tighter.
decisions.replacement: With a sound like a drum bursting, someone’s body sailed through the air. Grinning, I looked down at Hyuk Mujin, who had landed right at my feet.

decisions.reason: 졌냐 is the clipped jab “Lose?” not a full “Did you lose?”
한바탕 is a fit, and 헛구역질 is retching, not gagging.
“You watched the whole thing. Why ask?” is the spoken match for 다 봤으면서 뭘 물어보십니까.
마지막 here is the discarded-sword move, which the next lines discuss.
내 칭찬 is my praise; SOL drops the possessor.
수준 차이 is a skill/level gap; “the gap between you” is vaguer.
Keeps 한 대 and 그렇게 해서; SOL drops the even-one-hit scoff.
Mujin’s spoken “could’ve” is the more natural contraction.
투덜거리다 is grumbling; “sulked” changes the action.
Keep 아니, and 쓰기로 한 is an agreement (“supposed to”), not merely “going to.”
decisions.replacement: “No, weren’t you supposed to use only fist techniques?”

decisions.reason: 지금부터 쓰려고요 is starting now; SOL’s “anyway” is not in the Korean.
“Well, go ahead, then” is the offhand 하시든가 better than “go ahead and do that.”
저놈 is “that bastard,” and 입 찢어지려고 is the splitting-grin idiom, not a literal mouth.
면박 as knocking him down a peg, with “largely agreed,” is more spoken than “give him a hard time.”
“Had as well” and “had too” are the same; no gain.
Keeps 먼저 장법을 꺼낼; SOL drops “first” and adds “resort.”
그뿐만이 아니지 has no leading “And.”
6성 is Qi Sense’s realm (“its”), but 탐색 is still search, not detect.
decisions.replacement:
> **System**
>
> - You used **Qi Sense**. At its current six-star realm, you can search for targets at Level 80 or below within 60 jang.
> - **Qi Sense** has identified the target.
>
> **Lv. 50 Hyuk Mujin**

decisions.reason: Keeps 그러나; SOL adds “all that” and drops the contrast.
상대방의 힘 is an opponent’s strength, not generic “someone’s.”
다만 introduces the limitation; SOL drops the connective.
나만큼은 아니지만 compares his level to Taekyung’s, not “his growth.”
내 옆에서 굴러서 is him getting dragged around at Taekyung’s side; SOL shifts the agent and intensifies to “hell.”
다니면서 is while traveling; SOL’s “since” / “imaginable” / “all that” overreach.
시선에 … 물었다 is he asked under that gaze; SOL adds “noticed” and drops the ask.
왜 그러세요 is why he’s acting/looking like that; “What is it?” loses the why.
Dropping “that” is the more spoken “I was just thinking you…”
커흠, 커흐흠 is comma then bang, not two bangs.
앞으로는 새끼손가락이다 is “you’re my pinky,” not the opaque “you’ll get the pinky.”
Marks 아픈 새끼손가락 as the set phrase being quoted.
이라는 말씀 is “so you’re saying,” which BASE flattens.
그런 말이 있으니까 is the deflection that the phrase merely exists.
Keeps teasing 우리 and 뒤로 빠지시고 as step back, not “step aside.”
한 귀로 흘린 is the full “in one ear and out the other,” which BASE leaves incomplete.
한 번 is once, not “first.”
“Didn’t even break a sweat” is the idiomatic match for 땀도 안 났는데요.
따라 웃었다 is smiling along with him, not smiling “back at” him.
땀 좀 keeps the understated “a little”; SOL drops 좀.
재밌는 상대 is a fun opponent; “interesting” is a register shift.
호승심 is competitive spirit, not pride.
검을 펼칠 때 is fighting with the sword, not drawing it.
재미없어질 텐데 is that it will stop being fun, not merely “less fun.”
The clipped “Sure you won’t regret saying that?” matches Taekyung’s taunt better.
이기는데요 is beating Taekyung; the pointed “beating you” lands the 팩트 폭력.
Naturalizes 동요한 가슴 and renders 팩트 폭력 as a brutal fact without the stiff “shaken heart … blatant facts.”
행동으로 보여 준다 is show through actions; SOL’s “prove themselves” plus the collapsed quote changes it.
그럴 생각 is what he intends; SOL adds “exactly.”
바라보며 is looking; “gazed” is a purple synonym.
Only a Job-line capitalization change; keep the established System rendering of 일류 무인.
돌파한 is broken through; SOL’s “pushed past” weakens the glossary verb.
“Didn’t envy” is the natural verb for 부럽지 않다 against “wasn’t envious.”
당신 때문에 쓰는 겁니다 is using them because of you, not “you’re making me.”
뭐든 좋습니다 is anything is fine, not “whatever you want.”
명령이 … 전달되고 is an order delivered in his head; “reached” / “mind” drift.
SFX spelling change only; no clear gain on 쏴아아아.
Keeps 순간 as the hinge into the next move; SOL makes a closed sentence and drops the moment.
Renumbers the noodle note to [^1] after the earlier technique notes are dropped.
Longer Whoooosh matches 쐐애애애액 against the shorter earlier whoosh.
“Faster than ever before” is the natural English for 지금껏 본 적 없는 속도.
터져 나갔다 is burst, not snapped; SOL also adds “aside.”
Same continuation of the spear, without the stiff “the spear’s movement did not end there.”
달려드는 is charging in; “closed in” softens it.
그나마 남아 있던 needs “few remaining,” but 솟구쳤다 is erupting upward, not spraying.
decisions.replacement: The few remaining bluestones shattered, and dirt erupted into the air.

decisions.reason: 어느새 물러난 is a completed retreat he looks at, not a retreat he watches in progress.
그럴 줄 알았지 is the clipped “Knew it.”
“Mixed in” is natural for 섞었죠; the English technique name already explains the footwork, so the footnote is extra.
그게 되나 is skeptical “can you even,” not a plain “you can do that?”
그래서 is “so,” not “and.”
The two-beat “Bland. Very bland.” matches 싱거워요. 한참.
그럴 수 있지 is “that’s possible,” not “that can happen.”
SOL drops 말을 마친 and the full-body 몸을 부르르 떨더니.
English flavor order “spicy Jin Ramen” naturalizes 진라면 매운맛 without losing the brand ladder.
Jin Taekyung was just named; “he charged” avoids the immediate repeat.
파공성 is a tearing-air sound; SOL’s “roar” is the wrong noise and drops the air-tear.
“Its blade” vs “the blade” is the same; no gain.
뿐만이 아니라 is “not just”; “merely” is stiffer.
힘과 힘의 충돌 is its own beat; deleting it collapses the two-part impact.
Keep the sky-splitting roar separate; SOL merges it and changes 쪼개지는 to a completed split.
다르다 is about Taekyung, which 괄목상대 confirms; “he” not “it.”
무색할 정도다 is that the phrase falls short, not the wordier “failed to describe it.”
Names Cheongpung as the eye-rubber so “he” cannot attach to Taekyung.
“Extreme Yang internal-energy cultivation technique” is cleaner than “of the Extreme Yang nature.”
떨림 as a tremor is the tighter noun for the spearhead’s faint shake.
Second 우우웅 is longer; Vrrrr mirrors the swell.
듣는다고 했다 is reported “could hear,” and 울음소리 is crying, not weeping-as-fact.
알아차리는 is notice, not recognize.
Keep 경지 without SOL’s extra “necessary,” 근골 as physique, and 준비를 끝마친 as fully prepared.
decisions.replacement: Internal energy that had reached the realm. A physique fully prepared to become a Peak master.

decisions.reason: SOL adds “Only,” which the Korean does not.
검이 아니라 is a contrastive correction; “But” belongs there.
The punchline after Sword Cry is the terse “A Spear Cry,” with 이니 already covered by the sword/spear correction.
“Stared openmouthed” naturalizes 입을 벌리는 without the hanging-mouth calque.
Same flavor-label naturalization as Jin Ramen: “spicy Puramyeon,” keeping 자 as “All right.”
Krrrnnng vs Krrrrrng is the same rumble spelling; no gain.
천근거력 is the force of a thousand catties, not “to move” them or a separate “bore down”; keep the unit note.
decisions.replacement: With the force of a thousand catties, the spear’s cry rang out even louder.[^2]

decisions.reason: The catch is shown on the page and the English name is transparent; drop the extra technique footnote.
Five-Element Plum Blossom Steps is already transparent English; the extra gloss is unnecessary.
They are brand names, and [^1] is the correct remaining noodle note.
Keep the catty unit note readers need, but renumber it to [^2] after the dropped technique notes.
decisions.replacement: [^2]: A catty is a traditional East Asian unit of weight. “A thousand catties” is an expression for tremendous force.
